scope_note: Independent visual review only (native PNG + 200px + native anatomy crops for each). Receipt root_visual_review + ledger status synced; no integration, manifest, research or power changes.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + native crops. Two distinct fully-clothed beings: Ashinaga with very long legs (normal arms) and Tenaga with very long arms (normal legs) gripping a fish with normal five-fingered hands — separate silhouettes, no rider/fusion. Cooperative shore fishing c04 under a dark storm sky c08 on a rocky coast. Elongated anatomy reads at 200px; dominates frame, low-angle sunset light; no text or borrowed design. c02/c07 satisfied.

Viewed native + 200px + native feet crops. Wildcat head, two eyes, branching antlers, tawny deer torso, lion-tufted tail; exactly four legs — two eagle-taloned forefeet and two cloven ox-hoofed hindfeet confirmed in crop — wingless variant, matching the heraldic hybrid c03. Charging low-angle with dust and backlight; menace through anatomy only (c04, no invented power). No text or borrowed design.

Viewed native + 200px + hand crops. Turquoise goggle rain-mask c02, exposed incisors and two curled jaguar canine tusks c03; two arms, each hand five fingers, opaque woven mantle. Heavy rain and celestial water pour around him c04 on a rocky highland c06. Reverent-awe monumental framing appropriate to a Mesoamerican rain deity; no invented weapon/headdress, no generic aura or text.

Viewed native + 200px + hand crops. Giantess c01 rising from a breaking sea wave, her lower body merging into churning water c02 at a moonlit rocky world-edge c05; two arms, both hands five-fingered. Monumental scale avoids any ordinary-woman reading; heavy opaque robe, no invented horn/crown/weapon and no disputed nine-sister equivalence. No text or borrowed design.
